findings.title: Cut-short discovery cycles reset the per-cycle budget
findings.detail: Scheduler.discover(None) clears self.refused and starts created = [] against discovery.proposals_per_cycle on every full cycle. A cycle ended by discover.GitHubUnavailable (72bb704) or GitHubRateLimited (round 3) sets last_discovery back to None, so it re-runs 15 min later (or after the reset) as a new full cycle with a fresh budget. If the cut came in the open-PR search loop after sc.gk.create succeeded for some candidates, those come back as 409 but candidates ranked below them can still be created up to the full budget, so an outage that keeps coming and going can create more DISCOVERED items per interval_hours than DESIGN 9.5b's per-cycle pacing intends. proposal.max_per_day (scout_hold_until) still caps the owner-facing cards. Fix: carry created/refused of a cut cycle into its re-run, or document that the budget is per attempt; test that a cycle that created one item then hit github_unavailable creates at most budget - 1 on the re-run.
